title: Slim scan --json report
description: One JSON document on stdout. Scan is an inventory and ranking heuristic, not a closed envelope. schemaVersion 2. importSites are runtime-only; typeOnlySites are type-only import/export declarations. sizeProvenance describes unpacked minBytes: estimated is the known min table after a complete install walk; measured is a complete walk of a package not in that table; partial is an incomplete walk (cap, unreadable, omitted, broken or escaping link), including known-size packages, and then sizeState is review; unknown is a missing install tree, including known-size packages (table minBytes may still be present). gzipBytes is always 0.36 × minBytes (a guess of the displayed min, not a second measurement). sizeState review is measurement quality, not ranking verdict review.

gzipBytes.description: Always 0.36 × minBytes when minBytes is present; a guess of the displayed min, not a second measurement.

sizeProvenance.description: estimated and measured are complete-like. Incomplete walks stay partial; missing installs stay unknown — even when a catalog minBytes is present.

sizeState.description: Copies sizeProvenance except partial → review and refuse verdict → refused. review is measurement quality, not ranking verdict review.
